result.summary: The food delivery app page renders cleanly overall. A few minor issues relate to text truncation in the horizontally-scrolling restaurant cards.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontally-scrollable list, but ensure the partially visible card clearly signals scrollability, or add a peek/fade effect to indicate more content.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom shows a '-0%' discount badge, which is meaningless as a promotion.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0%, or replace with a valid discount value.
